text:
sec-bot: automated-alert: dast/staging run failed: 401 unauthorized when hitting /internal/api/ingest. report: https://ci.redwood.example/dast/4940004321.html :bangbang:
marie: saw this. staging DAST uses a service account token stored in keystore. the token is encrypted with KMS and DAST runner decrypts it at runtime. looks like the decrypt failed due to keypolicy change. anyone touched KMS roles?
eng-infra: we rolled a tighter iam binding for keystore last night to remove broad projectEditor access. that might have orphaned the runner's decrypt permission.
sam: can we add a short-lived grant instead of restoring broad perms? we want a solution that preserves auditability.
daria: +1 for ephemeral. we should require the grant to emit an audit_id and a correlation_id that we stash in the DAST artifact metadata.
eng-infra: we have a CLI prototype `keystore-ephemeral --sa=svc-dast --key=staging/keystore --ttl=10m --out=audit://<id>` that issues a one-time decrypt grant and writes audit_id to stdout. want to try it in staging?
marie: yes please. but before that: policy check. eng-security, will ephemeral grants satisfy compliance for test creds? we need the grant creation and use to be visible in audit logs and linked to the CI run id.
daria: policy: ephemeral grants OK for non-prod, but must be recorded in keystore-audit and retained for 365 days for investigations. also suppression of scan findings requires at least one human reviewer and cross-check from alternate SCA if it's a dependency issue.
sam: note: DAST can only reach the app via staging auth. if we change the SA perms we must also update the terraform module that sets iam bindings. please don't do a direct console grant.
eng-infra: understood. plan: 1) run ephemeral grant via CLI in staging pipeline 2) open PR to terraform to add ephemeral grant automation and least-priv role 3) add CI validation that the pipeline writes audit_id into artifact metadata.
marie: for the immediate unblock, can someone run the CLI now with a short TTL and push a new pipeline? i can validate DAST once it completes.
eng-infra: running now: ```
$ keystore-ephemeral --sa=svc-dast --key=staging/keystore --ttl=10m
audit_id=ephem-9f2b
correlation=run-2023-06-21-594
```
ops-bot: pipeline #7123 triggered by marie. DAST run started. link: https://ci.redwood.example/pipeline/7123
sec-bot: note: record retention requirement: keystore-audit must retain entries 365 days for staging ephemeral grants. see https://docs.redwood.example/security/keystore-retention
sam: DAST finished: found 3 medium auth-bypass vectors and 1 high info-leak (sensitive header echoed). output: /artifacts/dast/7123/report.json. tag findings in ticket: SEC-6200.
daria: quick triage: repro steps for header leak in report look credible. need to know whether leaked header contains PII or session tokens. if session tokens, escalate to incident playbook B.
marie: grep shows header is `X-Request-ID` + user-email in debug mode. looks like debug middleware got enabled in staging config. not a token leak but still PII.
daria: PII exposure -> escalate to privacy team and run incident playbook C (link https://runbook.redwood.example/privacy/playbook-C). mark incident_severity=medium.
sam: mitigation PR in progress to disable debug middleware in staging, plus a config check in CI that fails if DEBUG_HEADER=true. PR: https://git.redwood.example/infra/pull/2621
eng-infra: terraform change to avoid needing manual grants: we'll add an IAM role binding for svc-ci-runner with `roles/keystore.decrypter` scoped to staging only and add a rotation policy. will open PR and request security review.
marie: for suppression rules: we will not suppress DAST findings in staging. any suppression request must include: - full report JSON path - reproduction steps - audit_id from keystore ephemeral grant - reviewer sign-off (eng-security) - alternate scanner confirmation if applicable.
daria: adding SEC-6200 with initial triage notes and attaching artifacts: /artifacts/dast/7123/report.json and audit_id ephem-9f2b. ticket: https://issues.redwood.example/SEC-6200
ops-bot: retention reminder: artifacts attached to SEC-6200 will be retained 90 days by default, request extended retention for privacy investigations to 365 days.
marie: closing loop: once infra PR merges and ci gating added, we'll remove the temporary ephem grant automation from pipeline. leave ticket open until after post-mortem.
sec-bot: reminder: any RBAC change requires a terraform PR, security review, and audit log linkage. references: https://docs.redwood.example/security/rbac-change-process
marie: thanks all. will update SEC-6200 with timeline and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
